query: WITH desired AS (SELECT d.id, d.provider_id, d.alias_name, regexp_replace(lower(trim(d.alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') AS desired_normalized FROM public.provider_name_aliases d WHERE d.source = 'workbook_import') SELECT d.alias_name, d.provider_id FROM desired d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.provider_name_aliases a WHERE a.source <> 'workbook_import' AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(a.alias_name)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = d.desired_normalized) ORDER BY d.alias_name LIMIT 20
